name: Total Fees And Taxes 45
definition: Amount of money associated with a service.

TotalOverheadApplied.name: Total Overhead Applied
TotalOverheadApplied.definition: Total amount of overhead applied to the transaction that impacts the settlement amount.

TotalFees.name: Total Fees
TotalFees.definition: Total amount of fees (charge/commissions) applied to the transaction that impacts the settlement amount.

TotalTaxes.name: Total Taxes
TotalTaxes.definition: Total amount of taxes applied to the transaction that impacts the settlement amount.

CommercialAgreementReference.name: Commercial Agreement Reference
CommercialAgreementReference.definition: Reference to the agreement established between the fund and another party. This element, amongst others, defines the conditions of the commissions.

DigitalNetworkFee.name: Digital Network Fee
DigitalNetworkFee.definition: Digital network fee assigned to a transaction.

NonStandardsSLAReferenceRule.definition: For each value of IndividualFee/Type, NonStandardSLAReference may only be present once.

TransactionOverheadElementRule.definition: One of the elements (TotalOverheadApplied, TotalFees, TotalTaxes, CommercialAgreementReference, IndividualFee, IndividualTax) must be present.
